In the break, my kick fades out every two bars. On purpose.

It's the same DS Kick settings as the main kick's sub layer, but through an Auto Filter high-pass at 25 Hz with an LFO ramp (62 %) pushing the cutoff up. Measured: over two bars the hits fall by 53 dB, then the filter snaps back.

On top, Beat Repeat: every two bars, on beat four (offset 12/16), it repeats the kick in 1/32 notes for one beat. Eight hits. Then the drop comes in at full level.

From Uhrwerk aus Blut, out now. Part 7 next: the scream.

#codechaos #sounddesign #abletonlive #hitech #newpsychedelicdeathart

The loudest tone in this scream is not played by the synth.

Operator makes a saw plus a feedback sine 13 times higher, through a band-pass at 9 kHz with 88 % resonance. With Redux off, I measured the energy at 5.9 and 7.6 kHz. Redux resamples at 8.14 kHz, so everything above 4.07 kHz folds back down: 8.14 - 5.9 = 2.2 kHz. With Redux on, 2.2 kHz is the loudest peak. Aliasing, used on purpose.

The bit depth is automated too: the first three screams get 7, 11 and 15 bits.
